{{Top|leg}}
A '''crystal mill''' was a room located inside a [[crystal factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garnib]]. Each factory hosted several crystal mills, which housed the [[sonic bath]]s used in the final shaping of [[Garnib crystal]].
